lessonTitle: 27. Studying a function and drawing its graph
lessonTitleEnglish: Studying a function and drawing its graph
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: Study plan: domain, parity and periodicity, zeros and sign intervals, monotonicity and extrema, range.
stages.headlineEnglish: Study plan: domain, parity and periodicity, zeros and sign intervals, monotonicity and extrema, range.

stages.headline: Example: y = x² − 2|x| is even; for x ≥ 0 it is (x − 1)² − 1. Zeros 0, ±2; minimum −1 at x = ±1; maximum 0 at x = 0.
